releaseNotes: v1.3.8 -- BREAKING CHANGE: cameras/doorbells are now created under a new 'Reolink Device Bridge' device (one per source) instead of directly under the app, to support real-time event-driven updates and proper device grouping. Existing installs must delete their current camera/doorbell devices and re-run discovery under each source to recreate them; dashboards and rules referencing old device IDs will need to be repointed. New: real-time event-driven updates (falls back to polling automatically if the connection can't be established or drops). New: PIR enable/disable for cameras (pirOn/pirOff). Fixed: a login bug where the 'new token acquired' log line could fire even when the Login response didn't contain a usable token, masking the real failure behind a misleading success line -- login failures now log the raw response instead. Fixed: the Login API call was missing the 'action' field sent by every other command. Corruption-recovery logging for the event connection is quieter now that soak testing confirmed it's benign, self-recovering noise under load. v1.3.6 -- Fixed a discovery-page bug where unchecking an existing device on a standalone (single-channel) source never removed it. Also relabeled the multi-channel apply toggle and device rows for clarity, and reworded the source-removal toggle to spell out its scope.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Reolink Integration
apps.description: Manages Reolink sources (standalone cameras, NVRs, Home Hubs) and creates camera/doorbell child devices.

drivers.name: Reolink Camera
drivers.description: Component driver for a standard Reolink camera channel.

drivers.name: Reolink Doorbell
drivers.description: Component driver for a Reolink doorbell channel, adds button-press (visitor) event.

drivers.name: Reolink Device Bridge
drivers.description: Internal per-source bridge device -- holds the real-time event connection and parents each source's camera/doorbell devices. Not user-facing; created automatically by the app.
